create_FixedSteptimeWrapperEnv: create a FixedSteptimeWrapperEnv instance wrapping a LocomotionGymEnv with a desired time between steps
reset_FixedSteptimeWrapperEnv: reset the FixedSteptimeWrapperEnv and record the timing of the reset for elapsed time tracking
step_FixedSteptimeWrapperEnv: step the wrapped environment with an action while enforcing the desired time between steps
get_elapsed_time: get the elapsed time in seconds since the last reset of the FixedSteptimeWrapperEnv
get_steps_per_second: get the average number of time steps per second from the FixedSteptimeWrapperEnv
